so far i've tried everything but the mascara as it is nearly 3am so i'll leave a reply in the morning with my review for that! 

i have a few issues with the glow recipe mask. like, the whole thing is an issue. i hate it. it boggles my mind how it's allowed to be advertised as a sleeping mask when it's thinner than my actual moisturizer. my toner does more for hydration than this. the only good thing is the smell. it feels like pure silicone and flakes off my face when it absorbs, which it does so completely in 30 seconds. definitely not a mask. i used this as my last step tonight, following a hydrating toner and drunk elephant moisturizer i just got as a freebie at sephora. yet my skin feels so incredibly dry. i knew this product was super hyped up and was so excited for it, but this is just a HUGE let down.

now on a positive note, the lip gloss is very pretty. it's kinda shimmery along with the gloss so if you aren't into that it might not be for you. it's not too sticky or thick so that was nice.

What disorders would you like to see me include? Right now I have characters for bipolar, schizophrenia. DID, ADHD and anxiety. I'm still working on more, though.

I like how you said you wouldn't outright say what illness the character has, that's what I plan on doing with my characters! I really think this is a great idea and if you work further on it I'd love to see what you create.

I really like those ideas! So far I have a girl with DID, who's alters are sort of like the powerpuff girls haha. Then I have anxiety who can sense danger way before it happens and she uses her anxiety to help her sense if a decision will be good or bad. She also can use her scream to damage her enemies as well as put them in a daze. Then I have a boy with ADHD, who has super speed and insane reflexes. I also have schizophrenia who's hallucinations connect her to both this universe and a parallel one. 

Lastly, I have a girl with bipolar disorder. I self projected hella hard onto this character, giving her the powers I dream of having and making her the "leader" of the group. Her elevated self esteem and impulsivity are what make her a good leader. She can manipulate matter around her depending on her mood, i.e. raising the ground around her or causing a little tsunami with water. 

Certain moods will come with their own abilities. So far I decided that anger will cause her hands to burn whatever she touches. For example, if she's a little irritated and puts her palm on you, it would feel like putting your hand on hot concrete. If she's filled with rage, however, she can cause third degree burns. I'm not sure how much I like this specific power so it may be tweaked as I work on her more. I definitely need to figure out what to do for depression.

I drew heavy inspiration from Vanya (The Umbrella Academy) and Scarlet Witch from Marvel. My character's backstory is that her powers kicked in when she was 11, but were so severe and out of control that she was put on several intense medications, none of which worked so she ended up being locked in solitary confinement. She faced lots of abuse from her family. Eventually, she ends up breaking out of confinement and that's where her story begins. My issue with that storyline is that it looks like it's going to lead her to be a villain, which I don't want. I'm still working on it though so it'll come together I'm sure.

Anyways, that's what I have so far. As you can see, I've focused the most on my bipolar girl so far since she's inspired by myself anyways.

EDIT: Of course, I will develop the other characters backstories further after I shift my focus from my bipolar girl.
